rationale: No supported, coverage-preserving workflow edit is identified. The workflow already enables Maven dependency caching via `setup-java` with `cache: 'maven'`, so the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE dependency-cache optimization is already present; the pattern's own contraindication is "An equivalent cache already exists," and adding a separate `actions/cache` step would be redundant. The only other workflow_yaml candidate, P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (changing `fail-fast: false` to `true`), would cancel the remaining JDK matrix job on a failure, reducing build/test coverage across Java 17 and 21 and contradicting the requirement to preserve intended coverage; its preconditions (an explicit study policy making remaining matrix results dispensable and verified required-check semantics) are not met, since `required_checks` is empty/not_verified. Other patterns (cancel-stale, change-filter, schedule suppression, test selection/prioritization) do not fit a repository_dispatch-triggered build or require ci_service/infrastructure changes outside workflow_yaml.
